note: Real pqp app, dev-bypass accounts, pt-BR, dark theme, an evening clock. Clips are seamless loops; the .webp beside each clip is its first frame.

clips.name: appearance
clips.description: Settings, Aparência e idioma: light then dark mode, the Lareira and Harmonia visuals, purple and pink accents, all applied live, then back to Clássico.

clips.name: call-join
clips.description: Hero loop: in the voice channel Lobby, Bia, Caio, Nico, Duda and Leo drop into the call one by one and their speaking rings light up.

clips.name: chat
clips.description: #geral: messages arrive from the crew, a reply, 🙌 reactions count up, Bia's poll gets votes (Zeca votes 20h) and Leo rolls 1d20 for initiative.

clips.name: profile
clips.description: Zeca's public profile page (/@zeca), scrolling gently down to the approved depoimentos and back.

clips.name: profile-phone
clips.description: Zeca's public profile page (/@zeca) as a phone draws it (390 wide), the avatar and the first depoimento at rest, scrolling down to both depoimentos and back.

clips.name: raise-hand
clips.description: In a call with a screen share on the stage, Caio then Nico raise their hands; the 'Fila pra falar' card lists Caio first, Nico second.

clips.name: share
clips.description: Bia starts a screen share in the voice channel sessao-de-sabado: the painted rooftop at dusk fills the stage, with the people in the call and the call chat below it.
